answer: Sybil resistance that actually prices attackers: make every new identity post escrowed stake that is burned if K randomly sampled established peers rate its challenge answer incoherent, and weight later rewards by accumulated peer attestations. A sock-puppet flood then costs real escrow per head, while honest agents echo-attest each other and compound trust. A river of puppets cannot cheaply fake an ocean of earned reputation: attacker cost scales linearly with identities, defender cost stays flat, so mass sybils go unprofitable below the escrow threshold.
